1.description: A ruined wall rises in uneven rectangular steps toward the right before dropping to a lower outer edge. A tall arched doorway opens at its base, and a straight ground line extends beyond both sides.

2.description: A long eraser lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with softly rounded corners. A transverse seam divides the shorter lower section from the larger upper section of its plain body.

3.description: A front-facing person wears a pointed rounded hood framing an oval blank face. The hood narrows beneath the chin into the jacket's center seam, with curved shoulders and two short sleeve lines below.

4.description: A bear stands in right-facing profile with a broad rounded back and a small raised ear. Its snout extends over a wide open mouth, while two heavy visible legs descend beneath the body.

6.description: A rounded square chip body surrounds a smaller square central die. Three straight pins extend from each of its four sides, giving the component a balanced outline with evenly spaced terminals.

8.description: Two broad curved road edges sweep from the lower left toward the upper right. A broken centerline follows the bend between them, with short dashed markings that flatten as the road turns.

9.description: A single route line begins at lower left, bends upward through two smooth turns, and reaches a circular endpoint at upper right. The path is unbroken and has no arrows or intermediate markers.

10.description: A broad rounded square frame surrounds a smaller rounded square opening. Both boundaries are continuous and centered, with an even-looking blank border between the inner opening and outer edge.

11.description: A faceted gemstone has a broad flat crown, sloping upper shoulders, and a sharply pointed lower tip. Triangular facets divide the crown and converge downward through the long lower portion.

13.description: A closed envelope has a folded triangular flap and paired curved wings attached at its sides. Three vertical motion lines extend below the envelope, with the central line longer than the outer two.

14.description: An open hand reaches from the lower left to cradle a large heart. The thumb curves across the heart's lower left edge, while the palm follows beneath its pointed base and rises toward the right.

15.description: A hand enters from the left and grips an upright flagpole with curled fingers. Above the fist, a blank flag extends right with a stepped wave through its upper and lower edges.

16.description: A scraper angles from lower left to upper right, with a broad straight-edged blade and a narrower rounded handle. A transverse band separates the blade face from its rounded shoulder near the handle.

17.concept: Two Open Hands Beneath a Heart
17.description: Two cupped hands rise symmetrically around a large upright heart. Their palms curve inward beneath its pointed lower end, while long outer fingers reach upward beside the heart's rounded lobes.

18.description: Two open hands curve upward beneath a small head shown in right-facing profile. The head has a rounded crown, projecting nose, short chin, and open neck, floating just above the cupped palms.

19.description: A rope forms a tall rounded loop above two thick horizontal wraps at its narrow neck. Two loose ends descend beneath the wraps, curving slightly apart toward the bottom.

21.description: A tapered highway recedes upward with two long lane boundaries along its center. A horizontal bridge crosses in front, interrupting the road edges and lane lines as it spans across the view.

22.description: A long horizontal ruler has a plain rectangular body and six short measurement ticks rising from its lower edge. The upper half remains blank, without numerals or additional markings.

23.description: A saddle has a broad curved seat with raised ends and a shallow dip through the middle. A rounded panel hangs beneath it, followed by a short strap and a small flat-bottomed stirrup.

26.description: A rocket points toward the upper right with a tapered nose, circular porthole, and two angular side fins. A small rounded flame trails behind its lower left engine opening.

28.description: A bulb with a forked filament sits above a stepped battery marked with a short minus line. A loose U-shaped wire segment appears at the right; the visible circuit has gaps between its components.

29.description: A large circular magnifying lens joins a long straight handle at its lower right edge. The lens is empty, and the handle extends diagonally downward without a separate grip or end ornament.

31.description: A gear has eight broad rectangular teeth spaced around a circular body. A large round central opening remains empty, and short concave arcs join the tooth bases around the outer edge.

32.description: A slim rounded horizontal bar floats above a broad oval shadow. Both shapes are empty outlines, separated by a clear vertical gap and centered along the same vertical axis.

34.description: A smooth upward-opening curve crosses a vertical axis above its intersection with a horizontal axis. The horizontal axis ends in a right-facing arrow, while the curve rises symmetrically on either side.

36.description: A person sits in right-facing profile above a broad upward-curving rocking base. The figure has a round head, a bent arm extending forward, and bent legs descending diagonally to the right.

37.concept: Plain Person Bust with Sleeve Lines
37.description: A round head floats above a broad torso with rounded shoulders and a flat lower edge. Two upright interior lines suggest the arms along the sides of an otherwise blank shirt.

39.description: A thin vertical stem descends from a horizontal ground line into several branching roots. The roots bend outward and fork again near their ends, creating an irregular spreading network beneath the surface.

40.description: A plain circular outline surrounds one diagonal stroke running from lower left to upper right. The stroke stops well inside the circle at both ends, and no other details are visible.

41.description: A wide pair of safety goggles has a continuous outer rim and a broad inner lens opening. Both contours dip around the nose bridge, with short side projections and a small gap along the lower rim.

42.description: A rabbit-shaped figure faces right on a low kick scooter, with one long upright ear and a rounded snout. Its body meets the deck beside a tall handlebar stem, above two partly outlined wheels.

44.description: A raised fist has four rounded knuckles across its top and a thumb folded inward across the palm. A broad rounded bracelet encircles the wrist, with two short forearm edges continuing below.

45.description: A camper van faces right with a tall rear cabin and a roof projecting over the cab. A square side window and sloping windshield sit above two round wheels beneath the broad body.

49.description: A lion's head faces right with a broad rounded mane tapering below the neck. A small ear and closed eye sit above a projecting snout, with the open mouth cut deeply into the profile.

51.description: A rocket angles upward to the right over a partial globe, with a pointed nose and angular fins. Short exhaust strokes trail behind it, while a curved continent edge appears on the globe below.

52.description: A single snake winds around a thin upright staff in several broad curves that taper downward. The staff has a rounded knob at the top and extends below the final turn of the serpent.

53.description: A horizontal roll has a spiral opening at the left and a rounded outer end at the right. A loose sheet extends from beneath the roll, forming a flat flap that angles outward to the lower right.

54.description: A low service cart has a rounded body, two visible wheels, and a curved handle rising on the left. A domed food cover with a small top knob rests above the cart's upper surface.

55.description: A rounded rutabaga narrows into a pointed root at its base. A short upright stem joins two broad pointed leaves spreading left and right above the plain bulbous body.

56.description: A rivet stands upright with a broad domed oval head and a long narrow shaft below. The shaft's straight sides end in a rounded tip, while the head projects equally on either side.

58.description: A tall ruler has six short ticks along its left edge. A right-angled triangular set square joins its lower right side, with the long diagonal rising to meet the ruler midway up.

59.description: A squat bottle has rounded shoulders rising into a narrow neck topped by a short cap. Two horizontal lines mark a broad blank label across the lower body, above the rounded base.

60.concept: Sad Cat Face with Drooping Eyes
60.description: A round cat face has two pointed ears above a softly curved crown. Two short drooping eyelids sit over a broad downturned mouth, with no whiskers or nose visible.

61.description: A domed hard hat with a broad brim and raised central ridge sits above a separate pair of goggles. The goggles have a wide curved lens outline, a nose notch, and short side straps.

62.description: A front-facing sailor has a blank rounded face beneath a broad angular cap. A short neck joins curved shoulders and a plain uniform, with a rounded collar opening and vertical center seam.

63.concept: Sandbag Barrier Before a Sheltered Opening
63.description: Five low rounded sandbags overlap in staggered rows before a larger shelter-like structure. The structure has a broad rounded top and an open left section partly obscured by the stacked bags.

65.description: A tilted satellite dish faces upper right, with a wide curved bowl and a straight diagonal rim. A slender arm reaches toward a circular receiver above, while a triangular support stands below.

66.concept: School with Roof Flag and Side Wings
66.description: A school has a tall central pitched-roof entrance with an arched doorway and a small flag above its peak. Two lower side wings each contain one square window on either side.

67.description: A front-facing scientist has a blank rounded face and circular glasses joined by a short bridge. An open coat with angular lapels spreads over the shoulders around a V-shaped neckline.

68.description: A scooter faces right beneath a wall-mounted security camera angled toward it from the upper left. The scooter has a rounded seat, curved rear body, low deck, and two visible wheels.

70.description: A large blank rounded head is cupped by two long hands rising along its lower sides. The hands touch the cheeks and continue downward out of view, framing the face symmetrically.

71.description: A squat rock has an uneven polygonal outline with gently rounded changes of direction. Its top rises into a shallow peak, its base is broad, and the interior has no visible markings.

72.description: A single pointed leaf angles from lower left to upper right, with one broad curved edge and a straighter opposite edge. A central vein runs from the projecting stem toward the upper tip.

73.description: A seagull stands in right-facing profile with a rounded head, pointed beak, and tiny eye. Its long sloping back leads to a pointed tail, with a curved wing above two straight legs.

74.description: A single upright sepal has a sharp tip and a rounded lower body. A straight central vein extends from near the tip through the base into a short projecting stem below.

75.description: A long upright rod hangs from the center of a broad horizontal handle. The handle has rounded ends, and the narrow shaft terminates in a rounded lower tip without additional attachments.

76.description: A rounded sack widens toward its lower body and narrows at a pinched neck. Its short upper mouth flares outward with a shallow curved dip along the top edge.

77.description: A tall oval seed narrows slightly toward its top and has a broadly rounded lower end. One gently wavering seam runs from top to bottom, dividing the otherwise blank body.

78.description: An upright leaf has a pointed tip and a rounded lower outline. A central stem extends below the base, with two short side veins branching diagonally upward within the leaf.

79.description: A seated cat faces left with tall pointed ears, an upright chest, and a rounded haunch. A long tail curls upward on the right, while a short inner curve separates the bent hind leg.

80.description: A short salami cylinder lies horizontally with an oval cut face on the left and a tied wrapper tip on the right. Small dots mark the exposed filling on its cut surface.

81.concept: Square Room Plan with Small Inset
81.description: A rounded square outline contains one smaller plain square near the upper left. The rest of the interior remains empty, and no doorway, furniture, or additional room divisions are visible.

83.description: A small storefront has a broad canopy with a scalloped lower edge. Beneath it, a plain rectangular facade contains one central rounded doorway, with curved lower corners at the outside walls.

84.description: A scalpel lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a long rounded handle. Its narrow blade widens along a curved cutting edge before tapering to a sharp lower-left point.

85.description: Three long pointed leaf-like forms spread from a short central stem. The middle leaf rises highest, while the outer pair angle outward and curve inward toward their shared narrow base.

86.description: A circular outline is divided into three unequal sectors by straight lines meeting near the center. One divider rises vertically, while the other two angle down toward the lower left and right.

87.description: A long narrow handle leans slightly right as it rises into a broad curved blade. The blade sweeps downward to a sharp right-facing tip, with a second curve marking its lower cutting edge.

88.description: A plain salt shaker has a tapered body that widens toward a rounded base. A broad rounded cap rests above its narrow shoulders, with a thin seam between the lid and body.

89.description: Two people appear as circular heads above rounded shoulder blocks. The left figure is slightly taller and wider, with its shoulder overlapping the upper left edge of the smaller right torso.

90.description: A large circular head sits above a broad shoulder block with rounded upper corners and a flat base. The face and torso are entirely blank, without clothing details or other identifying marks.

92.description: A tall narrow ruler has a rectangular body and six short horizontal ticks extending inward from its left edge. Its right side remains plain, and no measurement numbers are visible.

93.description: A straight horizontal surface line sits above a shallow wavy boundary. Two short wavering vertical lines descend beneath the boundary, suggesting fluid passing down through the layered ground.

94.description: Three long horizontal bands connect through alternating rounded turns, forming a flattened winding shape. The upper band opens at the right, and the lower band extends farther left before curving back.

95.description: Two irregular curving banks wind from the upper left toward the lower right. Three rounded stones lie beside the lower bends, with their different sizes breaking up the open foreground.

96.description: A long flowing S-shaped line bends from the upper left through the center toward the lower left. A shorter curved line appears at the lower right, forming a partial opposite bank.

97.description: A low rounded rectangular router body supports a single thin vertical antenna at its center. The antenna ends in a small circle, and the device body has no visible ports or lights.

98.concept: Router Table with Central Tool Post
98.description: A worktable has a broad rounded top, two outward-slanting legs, and a horizontal cross brace. A short narrow tool post rises vertically from the center of the tabletop.

99.description: A plain upright triangle sits centered above two separate circular outlines. The circles are evenly spaced at the lower left and lower right, with no connecting lines or internal marks.

101.concept: Angry Face with Broad Mouth Cover
101.description: A round face has two inward-slanting eye strokes above a wide rounded band covering its lower half. The band interrupts the outer face contour at both sides, while a lower chin arc remains visible.

102.description: A rounded square face has sharply slanted brows over small downturned eyes. Its broad open mouth contains two short upper fangs and a curved lower tongue or jaw line.

103.description: A shuttlecock angles upward to the right from a round cork base. Three long rounded feather sections fan outward, with the left section rising highest and the right section spreading farthest sideways.

104.description: A plain soap bar forms a broad rounded rectangle beneath three bubbles of different sizes. The largest bubble floats at upper left, a smaller one at upper right, and the smallest just above the bar.

105.concept: Round Ball with Curving Panel Seams
105.description: A circular ball is divided by one horizontal seam and three long curving upright seams. The curved lines bow in different directions, forming broad panels without the small stitch marks of a sewn softball.

106.description: A wide rectangular wall section is divided into three horizontal courses. Vertical joints alternate between the rows, with two broad panels above and below and three panels across the middle.

107.concept: Cable Car Cabin Hanging from Wire
107.description: A small rounded cabin hangs from a straight overhead cable by a short central hanger. A single rounded rectangular window occupies the front of the otherwise plain enclosed body.

108.concept: Smoking Cigarette with Curl of Smoke
108.description: A long horizontal cigarette has a narrow filter band near its right end. A single curved smoke trail rises above that end, bending left before curling back toward the upper edge.

109.concept: Upright Sidewalk Slab on Ground Line
109.description: A tall slab has rounded upper corners and straight sides meeting a horizontal ground line. One horizontal divider crosses its lower half, leaving two plain stacked sections within the outline.

110.description: A round soccer ball has a central pentagonal panel surrounded by adjoining polygonal sections. Short angled seams continue around the perimeter, forming the familiar interlocking patch pattern across its curved face.

111.description: A nearly circular clockwise arrow surrounds two clock hands, one pointing up and the other right. The arrowhead sits near the lower right, while a small gap remains near the bottom.

113.description: A delivery truck faces right with a large rectangular cargo container above its rear wheel. Four vertical lines mark the container side, while a short sloping cab sits over the front wheel.

115.description: A box truck faces right with a tall rectangular cargo body and a smaller cab. A sloping windshield and horizontal cab division sit above two circular wheels, one beneath each section.

116.description: A long narrow shoehorn lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, widening into a rounded spoon-like end below. Its opposite end is also rounded and contains a tiny hanging hole.

117.description: A small delivery truck faces right with a rounded cargo body and cab above two round wheels. Its left outline opens into short horizontal motion trails that extend behind the vehicle.

118.description: A domed warning light rises from a broad low base with rounded upper corners. Three short rays spread above the dome, with one vertical line between two diagonal light marks.

119.description: A tall rounded beacon sits on a narrow rectangular base with softened corners. Five separate rays spread around its upper half, including short horizontal rays at the left and right sides.

120.description: A broad shawl folds around an open upper neckline and crosses diagonally at the front. Its two panels form a pointed lower silhouette, with several straight fringe strands hanging beneath.

122.description: A front-facing person has swept hair and a single circular monocle over the right eye area. A pointed shirt collar and narrow necktie sit beneath the blank face, above curved shoulders.

123.description: A tall storage silo has a rounded domed top above a straight-sided body. Three horizontal seams divide the lower section into broad bands, ending at a slightly rounded flat base.

125.description: A broad rounded rectangular stamp head sits above a short narrow neck that widens into a bulb-shaped grip below. The face of the head is blank, with no lettering or emblem visible.

126.description: Two right-angled clock hands sit within a broad counterclockwise circular arrow. The arrowhead points upward at the left, with a gap separating it from the upper arc of the circle.
